response.courseDescription: 437 [M] Cougar Investment Fund I Students manage a portion of the university's endowment; including security analysis, valuation, equilibrium, market efficiency, and modern portfolio theory. Credit not granted for more than one of FIN 427 and 437.
response.coursePrerequisites: FIN 325 with a C or better; admitted to a major or minor in the College of Business, or the major in Economic Sciences.  Enrollment not allowed if credit already earned for FIN 427.
